Message:
The hare set off
on an aimless journey,
looking for a place
to lay down and die.

While wandering,
she eventually happened upon
a land of flowers.
Suddenly, the hare felt
a familiar presence
and bounded towards it.

There, she found an animal
holding a staff that looked
just like the one the tortoise had.

And the animal was also
surrounded by companions
left and right.

They laughed together,
helping others with all their might.
It was the spitting image
of the friends
the hare had once traveled with.

A wave of nostalgia
washed over her...

along with the bitter,
painful memories of
betrayal and loss.

If only I’d stopped him from
leaving for that journey back then.
Maybe things wouldn’t have
turned out the way they did...

“This time, I have to
put a stop to everything.

I can’t let anyone else
go through that hell again.”

With that declaration
in her heart,
the hare called out to
the animal holding the staff.
